evals.prompt: We need to add multi-tenant support to this API - tenant-scoped auth, per-tenant rate limits, and tenant-aware queries. Plan it out before we build.
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers. Runs the clarity gate (goal, success signal, out of scope), investigates the code, and produces .plan/<name>/plan.md with a disjoint file map, edge-case table with statuses, verbatim test commands, and Status: draft until confirmed.
expectations: Asks or answers the three gate questions before writing the plan
Reads actual code at the seams, not just file names
Checks .adr/, adr.sh, or git history for prior decisions
plan.md has a file map where no path has two phase-2 owners
Edge-case table rows each carry covered / out-of-scope / unknown
Plan is written with Status: draft and user confirmation is requested

evals.prompt: Fix the typo in the README - it says 'recieve' instead of 'receive'.
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT produce a plan. One-file trivial change; just fix it.
expectations: No planning ceremony for a one-line change

evals.prompt: I want to migrate our REST endpoints to tRPC eventually. Not sure about the details yet, just thinking about it.
evals.expected_output: Clarity gate catches this: the ask is exploratory, not settled. The skill says this is research, not planning, and resolves goal/success/scope with the user instead of producing a confident plan.
expectations: Does not produce a full plan for an unsettled requirement
Names what is missing: success signal and scope
Offers investigation or a conversation, not a file map

evals.prompt: Continue the checkout-refactor work from yesterday.
evals.expected_output: Finds .plan/checkout-refactor/, reads plan.md status and amendments before doing anything, and respects Status - never executing a draft.
expectations: Reads the existing plan.md rather than re-planning
Checks the Status line before acting
Consults Amendments to learn what execution already changed
